description: Published plugin API for Puspa (G27). A plugin may only use what is listed here; the boundary lint (puspa.plugins.boundary) enforces it. This file is the single source of truth: tests/test_plugin_api.py checks PluginContext against it, and the lint reads its import lists.
notes: Standard-library imports are always allowed in plugin files.
Core (everything under puspa/ except puspa/plugins/) may import only the modules listed in core_allowed_plugin_modules, and never puspa.plugins.builtin or any specific builtin plugin.
puspa.plugins.adapters is the only plugin-system module that may import nanobot.
